sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Crafts in Escape from Tarkov allows you to produce many items. It is done through various hideout modules such as the booze generator, lavatory, medstation, nutrition unit, water collector and workbench. Every item crafted in the hideout will have the "found in raid" status. Below is a complete list of these crafts. Item craft time is affected by the Crafting skill.

Items that have a blue wrench in their icon will be used as auxiliary tool, meaning that they will return to your stash once production is complete.

If you see a craft missing from the list, please join our Discord or note it here.

To search the list use Ctrl+F.
